api.model_gate_no_weeks: There are no weeks with ground truth outside the training of both versions to compare them.
api.retrain_no_labels: This dataset has no ground truth: retraining is only possible with labeled transactions.
api.retrain_few_weeks: The ground truth covers only {weeks} week(s); retraining needs at least {min_weeks} labeled weeks.
api.retrain_no_laundering: The ground truth has no laundering marked; there is nothing for the model to learn.
api.retrain_feedback_few_labels: Retraining with feedback needs at least {min_labels} labels {scope, select, analysts {from analysts} other {from analyst and simulated feedback}} in closed periods; there are {total}.
api.retrain_feedback_no_laundering: The feedback has no confirmed laundering yet (reported alert): the model would learn only from false positives.
api.retrain_feedback_no_false_positive: The feedback has no confirmed false positive yet: the model would learn only from laundering.
api.retrain_plan_few_labels: {used} feedback labels are left in the training weeks{reserved, plural, =0 {} other { ({reserved} fall in validation or after the cutoff of {train_end})}}; retraining with feedback needs at least {min_labels}.
api.retrain_plan_missing_class: The training weeks have no {missing, select, laundering {confirmed laundering} other {confirmed false positive}} label{reserved, plural, =0 {} other { ({reserved} fall in validation or after the cutoff of {train_end})}}.

api.source_auth_refused: User or password refused by the server.

api.source_no_permission: The user has no read permission on that table.

api.compat_control_missing: The column does not exist in the table.

api.compat_sample_columns: Columns are missing, so the sample cannot be validated.

api.compat_sample_error: Error on line {line}{with_column, select, yes {, column {column}} other {}}: {message}
api.compat_truth_yes: The source has ground truth: it can be measured and retrained.
api.compat_truth_no: The source has no ground truth: there will only be model scores, no retraining.
api.compat_suggest_fix: Fix the items marked in red before importing.
api.compat_suggest_no_data: No data in the current dataset to compare: choose by where the data comes from.
api.compat_suggest_extend: {pct, number}% of the sample accounts already exist and the dates come right after the current data: it looks like a continuation of the current dataset.
api.compat_suggest_same_base: {pct, number}% of the sample accounts already exist and the dates overlap the current dataset's: it looks like the same base already loaded, and importing would duplicate transactions. Check the source; if it really is another base, import it as a separate dataset.
api.compat_suggest_cross: {pct, number}% of the accounts already exist, but the dates overlap periods of the current dataset (closed weeks do not change): prefer a separate dataset.
api.compat_suggest_other: Few accounts in common or dates from another era: it looks like another dataset with the same structure.
api.compat_suggest_uncertain: The assessment is uncertain (accounts and dates do not point either way): decide by where the data comes from.
